name: @rockysurf/provider-conformance
description: SDK conformance checks every compute provider runs against itself. Test-only; never a runtime dependency.
_comment: TWO RESOLUTIONS, ON PURPOSE (rockysurf-92nv). In this workspace `main`/`types`/`exports` point at SOURCE: provider packages depend on this one from their TESTS, `pnpm run check` runs `test` without running `build`, and pointing at `dist/` would mean every provider's test run needs this package compiled first. Published, it must ship real code, so `publishConfig` swaps the same three fields to `dist/` — pnpm applies those overrides at `pnpm pack`/`publish` time, so the tarball an out-of-tree author installs resolves compiled JavaScript while the workspace keeps its build-order-free test runs. Verified by tarball in scripts/verify-tarballs.mjs.
